# iOS Local LLM

> iOS Local LLM is a Swift/SwiftUI local-first AI workbench for iPhone and
> Apple silicon Macs. It runs language, vision,
> speech, and image-generation workflows on-device and exposes optional,
> authenticated local APIs for AI clients and agents.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/ios-local-llm
License: MIT for original project code and documentation
Swift module and Xcode scheme: IOSLocalLLM

## Capabilities

- On-device LLM chat and code assistance with MLX and llama.cpp
- Camera, screenshot, OCR, and vision-language-model analysis
- Local transcription, voice activity detection, and text-to-speech
- On-device image generation
- Hugging Face model discovery, admission checks, downloads, and lifecycle
- Thermal-aware generation and coordinated model residency
- OpenAI-, Anthropic-, and Ollama-compatible local HTTP routes
- Structured tool calling and a pairing-authenticated iPhone-to-Mac agent link

## Important boundaries

- Model weights and generated native frameworks are not included in Git.
- Downloaded models have independent licenses.
- Local API access is opt-in, bearer-authenticated HTTP for trusted networks.
- The project does not silently send local prompts or captures to a cloud
  inference service.
- Simulator results do not prove physical-device thermal or Jetsam behavior.
